name: @lanka-playgrounds/micro-frontends
description: Two modules in two frameworks, each built on its own, on one page: what they must share, and what happens when they do not.

scripts.//test:coverage: The suite without --coverage, on purpose. Nothing under src/ runs as source: the modules run as the BUNDLES a real vite build made of them, and the build runs in globalSetup, in the main process. v8 would report 0% for code the scenes exercise completely, and a threshold over that number could only be one that cannot fail.
